estimate_qualification: Subjective and uncalibrated; not a correctness probability.
new_partials: For all SU(3) irreducibles and integral c, 1+c chi is nonnegative only in the trivial or standard-adjoint-square cases.
Every integral virtual character that is a finite convex combination of irreducible SU(3) squares is already one square, without a weight cutoff.
blocked_route: Positive fractional averages of irreducible SU(3) squares cannot produce a counterexample. Positivity-to-convex-square decomposition remains unproved and cannot be assumed.
